comment: A mirror of a rib and of a web To Next (mitcad#2431): the block is 20 mm high left of x = 30 and 10 mm right of it (Sketch1 F1, Extrude1 F2, Body1 F2.b0; Sketch2 F3, Extrude2 F4 joined), 36000 mm3.

Rib1 (F7) on Plane1 (F5, XZ offset to y = 20: its normal +Y, its sketch y -Z; Sketch3 F6): the line from x = 5 to 25 at z = 40, 4 thick on side 1 (+Y, y = 20 to 24), grown to the left of the line with the normal up (down, -Z) to the next face, the higher top at z = 20: 20 * 4 * 20 = 1600 mm3 more, its centre at (15, 22, 30).

Mirrored across x = 30 with Adjust (the default of a new mirror, Mirror1 F8): the image is built again from the line x = 35 to 55 at z = 40 down to the lower top there (z = 10), on the same side of the plane y = 20 (y = 20 to 24: the reflected frame's normal is -Y, the rib's side 2 there): 20 * 4 * 30 = 2400 mm3 more, its centre at (45, 22, 25). The body's centre: (25.8, 20.2, 10.2); with the thickness on the other side it would be at y = 19.96.
Identical reflects the finished rib: it ends at z = 20, 10 mm above the lower top, and reaches no body, as mirrors of ribs did before.

expect.error_contains: no copy of Rib1 reaches a body

comment: A web: the rib and its mirror suppressed, Web1 (F11) on Plane2 (F9, XY offset to z = 40; Sketch4 F10): the line from (15, 5) to (15, 35), 2 thick on side 1 (to its left looking along it with the normal +Z up: x = 13 to 15), flipped down to the next face (z = 20): 2 * 30 * 20 = 1200 mm3 more, its centre at (14, 20, 30).

Mirrored across x = 30 (Mirror2 F12, Adjust): built again from x = 45 to 47 (the image of x = 13 to 15) down to the lower top (z = 10): 2 * 30 * 30 = 1800 mm3 more, its centre at (46, 20, 25); the body's at x = 25.6308 (25.5385 with the thickness on the other side of the line).
